name: Winter, Cynical Opportunist
oracle_text:
Deathtouch
Whenever Winter attacks, mill three cards.
Delirium — At the beginning of your end step, you may exile any number of cards from your graveyard with four or more card types among them. If you do, put a permanent card from among them onto the battlefield with a finality counter on it.
blocked_sentences: Delirium — At the beginning of your end step, you may exile any number of cards from your graveyard with four or more card types among them. If you do, put a permanent card from among them onto the battlefield with a finality counter on it.

needs.what: a player choice of any number of cards from their own graveyard constrained as a SET: the union of the chosen cards' card types must be at least N (four here); the chosen cards are exiled and bound (as) so a following effect can pick one permanent card from among exactly those, put it onto the battlefield with a finality counter, and the 'if you do' branch runs only when the exile happened
needs.why_existing_wont_do: exile/search_zones take a per-card selector (types, any_types, count) with no constraint over the chosen set's combined card types; the `distinct` value can count types after the fact but cannot restrict what the player may choose; choose_permanents (with max_total_power) is the only set-constrained chooser and it reads the battlefield only; a cost key exile_from_graveyard is a fixed-count cost, not a resolution-time optional set with a type-union floor
